papers.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
papers.desc: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices.

papers.title: Non-penetrating World Models
papers.desc: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models.

papers.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.desc: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos.

papers.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
papers.desc: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures.

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.desc: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives.

papers.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
papers.desc: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world.

papers.title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
papers.desc: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions.

papers.title: Intent Contracts: Taking Tools Away from Agents
papers.desc: Intent contracts are an authorization interface for tool-using LLM agents in which the planning model holds no tools.

papers.title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
papers.desc: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies.

papers.title: Exploited Before It Was Fixed? Vulnerability Timelines from Open, Machine-Readable Evidence
papers.desc: -05-X-03), Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalogs, and exploitation sightings.

papers.title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
papers.desc: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference.

papers.title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
papers.desc: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay.

papers.title: Which Dwarf Is This? Doppeldwarf-306 and Near-Identical Instance Retrieval
papers.desc: Most established instance-retrieval benchmarks emphasise landmarks; small sculptures from visually similar series offer a complementary challenge.

papers.title: Motion-Aware Reward Modeling for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
papers.desc: Reward models for instruction-guided video editing can favor temporal consistency at the expense of motion.

papers.title: Autoregressive View Model
papers.desc: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation.
